	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_building = gatehouses_4
			aub_can_upgrade_to_gatehouses_5_trigger = yes
			aub_can_pay_gold_building_cost_trigger = { GOLD = regular_building_cost_tier_5 }
		}
		upgrade_building_effect = gatehouses_4
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = gatehouses_5 }
			aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = regular_building_cost_tier_5 }
		}
	}
}

# gem_freeminers_1: 2 frozen upgrade edge(s)
